misconceptions.description: Student accesses index N instead of N-1, or starts loop at 1 instead of 0
observable_patterns: Loop condition uses i <= arr.length instead of i < arr.length
Accesses arr[n] which is out of bounds
Prefix sum array of size n instead of n+1
misconceptions.invariant: Valid indices are 0..n-1. Loop i < n ensures i never reaches n.

transfer_templates.question:
Array: [3, 1, 4, 1, 5], n=5
Your loop: for(int i=0; i<=5; i++)
When i=5, what is arr[5]? What happens?
transfer_templates.target_reasoning: arr[5] is out of bounds — valid indices are 0..4. Fix: i < 5 (or i < n).

misconceptions.description: Student shrinks the sliding window before the invariant is violated
observable_patterns: Shrinks window on every iteration instead of only when invariant fails
Uses fixed window logic for variable-window problems
misconceptions.invariant: Shrink the window only when the window violates the required property.

transfer_templates.question:
Array: [2, 1, 5, 2, 3, 2], k=7 (find subarray with sum >= k)
Window [2,1,5] has sum=8 >= 7. Do you shrink it now? What rule tells you when to shrink?
transfer_templates.target_reasoning: Shrink only when current window sum < k is violated (i.e., sum >= k met, shrink to find smaller valid window). Record current window size before shrinking.

misconceptions.description: Student moves the wrong pointer in a two-pointer approach
observable_patterns: Moves left pointer when result is too small (should move right)
Moves right pointer when sum is too large (should move left)
misconceptions.invariant: If current value < target: move the pointer that increases the value. If current value > target: move the pointer that decreases the value.

transfer_templates.question:
Sorted array: [1, 3, 5, 7, 9], target sum=10
left=0 (value=1), right=4 (value=9), sum=10. What do you do?
Now left=0 (value=1), right=3 (value=7), sum=8 < 10. Which pointer moves and why?
transfer_templates.target_reasoning: sum=8 < 10: need to increase sum. Move left pointer right: left++. Moving right-- would decrease sum further.
